name: stri_datetime_parse
title: Date and Time Formatting and Parsing

origin.description: Parses strings with an ICU pattern or a named style.
origin.usage: stri_datetime_parse(str, format = "uuuu-MM-dd HH:mm:ss", lenient = FALSE, tz = NULL, locale = NULL)

arguments.name: format
arguments.text: An ICU pattern, or a style such as date_long.

arguments.name: lenient
arguments.text: Single logical value. TRUE accepts a day that rolls into the next month.

arguments.name: tz
arguments.text: NULL or "" for the default time zone, or one ICU time zone identifier.

arguments.name: locale
arguments.text: NULL or "" for the default locale.

origin.details: Fields the pattern does not mention stay at midnight today in tz. A string that does not match is missing.
origin.example:
x <- stri_datetime_parse("2015-02-28", "yyyy-MM-dd", tz = "UTC")
cat(paste0("stri_datetime_parse(\"2015-02-28\", \"yyyy-MM-dd\", tz = \"UTC\") returns ", sprintf("%.0f", unclass(x)), ".\n"))

translation.description: Parses strings with an ICU pattern or a named style.
translation.usage: stri_datetime_parse(str, format="uuuu-MM-dd HH:mm:ss", lenient=False, tz=None, locale=None)

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: A string, NA, or a list of those. None is an empty vector.

arguments.name: format
arguments.text: An ICU pattern, or a style such as date_long.

arguments.name: lenient
arguments.text: True accepts a day that rolls into the next month. NA is an error.

arguments.name: tz
arguments.text: None or "" for the default ICU zone, or one zone identifier.

arguments.name: locale
arguments.text: None or "" for the default locale.

translation.details: Unspecified fields are cleared after the calendar is set to now, so a date-only pattern is midnight in tz. A string that does not match is NA. Parsing uses ICU.
translation.value: A float, or NA. A list or tuple returns a list.
translation.example:
from stringi.datetime import stri_datetime_parse
x = stri_datetime_parse("2015-02-28", "yyyy-MM-dd", tz="UTC")
print(f'stri_datetime_parse("2015-02-28", "yyyy-MM-dd", tz = "UTC") returns {x:.0f}.')
